name: Immersive Gallery
summary:
Immersive Gallery turns the photos you love into 3D worlds that surround you. Pick a photo from your Meta Quest and, in about 10 to 20 seconds, it becomes a world you can stand in, look around and lean into - with its floor lined up with your real floor.

EVERYTHING HAPPENS ON YOUR HEADSET
An AI depth model runs right on your Meta Quest. Your photos are never uploaded, there are no accounts, no analytics and no ads.

YOUR OWN GALLERY
- All your worlds in one window you can move and resize
- Choose Standard,
